title: Bluesky wants to make it easier to buy, sell, and fundraise on the network | TechCrunch
summary: Schneider said he understands that users can leave Bluesky for another platform if the company introduces features or changes they dislike, a reality that he said keeps the leadership team accountable as it prepares to introduce monetization in the coming months.
